notes: Excluded for system, the first code that applies. The first page of the PDF holds the title An Online Federated Learning Framework via Over-the-Air Computing for UAV Object Detection and DOI 10.1109/TVT.2024.3461650. The work is area 7 (federated object detection with misaligned AirComp aggregation, pp. 2-3), so it passes no_learning, above_phy and function. The link is scalar: channel power gain h_k = beta0 d^-2 on p. 2, scalar symbols and a scalar received signal r(t) on p. 3, and no antenna array, MIMO, beamforming or RIS appears anywhere in the paper, including Table II (p. 4). The paper never writes single antenna in words, so the reviewer may confirm; if the over-the-air aggregation is judged not to be the paper's own problem, the code would be function instead.
